verses.1: Oh children, do not follow the advice of those who oppose Jehovah. Do not seek to cover up your sins, nor do you try to hide them from Him. Do not let your souls be used as a means to cover up one sin with another.
verses.2: They went down to Egypt, not asking for any protection from Pharaoh’s protection, nor seeking any shelter in Egypt’s shelters.
verses.3: And it shall be a benefit to you that Pharaoh protects you, and gives you protection in Egypt for all time.
verses.4: For their rulers and administrators were corrupt and wicked.
verses.5: All pride is harmful to those who do not deserve it. It does not help or benefit anyone; instead, it brings only shame and humiliation.
verses.6: They shall carry them in the wilderness, in a land of suffering and hardship. They shall bring them to him who can use them for good. But those who refuse to do so will be punished.
verses.7: And the Egyptians will be in a state of chaos and destruction. I called them “rahab”. Now they have returned.
verses.8: Now write it down on their palms and on the book of laws. May it be a forever reminder for them.
verses.9: For the people of Meri are like children who do not listen to the words of Jehovah.
verses.10: They said, “To those who see, do not see; and to those who interpret, do not interpret.” They told us what they knew. They shared with us some of their insights.
verses.11: May those who are on the path of destruction be removed from before us, and may the holiness of Israel be preserved.
verses.12: Therefore, this is what the Holy Israel said: “Because you have trusted in these words, and because you have relied on them, you will be destroyed and will be left without any hope.”
verses.13: Therefore, this “trouble” will be like a fallen tree that lies in the ground, completely destroyed. But suddenly, it will be restored to its former state again.
verses.14: And its branches will be broken, just as a tree’s branches are broken. There will be no hope for it; no one will find any hope in its destruction. It will not be able to burn away the flames from the mountain, nor to clear out the waters from the depths of the earth.
verses.15: For as Adonai Yehovah has said, “Israel will be restored and will be blessed in peace and security. Then your glory will increase, and you will not be destroyed.”
verses.16: And they said, “Not on a horse; let them ride on their backs. And not on a light vehicle; let them travel easily.”
verses.17: One thousand people will stand before one outburst of anger. Five times they will try to climb up the mountain’s peak, but they won’t succeed.
verses.18: And so, Jehovah will wait for your repentance. And then He will show you His mercy, for Jehovah is a God of judgment.
verses.19: For the people of Zion, who live in Jerusalem, they will not cry out for help. They will not seek refuge in your voice when they hear your cries.
verses.20: And He gave you bread in abundance, and water to drink. Do not be afraid anymore; your eyes will see your Lord.
verses.21: And your ears will hear words from behind you, which say, “This is the way to go. Follow it, so that you may believe and be saved.”
verses.22: And they will cover your beautiful jewelry with dirt, and the gold decorations on your clothes will be ruined. They will treat them like worthless trash.
verses.23: And He gave you seeds of your own kind, so that you could plant them in the land. But there will be thorns and weeds among your crops on that day. It will be a time of great trouble for you.
verses.24: And the thousands and millions of people who dwell in the fields, in the cold nights, will eat what has been left over from the harvest.
verses.25: And on all the mountains and hills, clouds of water would rise on the day of great destruction from the heights.
verses.26: And the light of the day will be like the light of fire. And that light will be seven times brighter than the light during the seven days of creation. On that day, Jehovah will break open the heavens and heal those who are sick.
verses.27: Look! The name of Jehovah comes from afar, from a forest full of flames. His lips are filled with anger, and his voice is like fire that burns everything around him.
verses.28: And his spirit, like a river that flows all the way to the heart, destroys nations with its torrential force. And the flames spread over the lives of people.
verses.29: The song shall be for you a time of holiness and joy in your hearts, just as it is when you go up to the mountain of Jehovah.
verses.30: And Jehovah shall make his voice heard; his branches will be shaken in anger. Flames will consume them, and fire will burn them up. Rocks will be scattered everywhere.
verses.31: For the voice of the LORD will be heard in Ashur, in its ruler.
verses.32: And all these things will be accomplished through the establishment that Jehovah will place upon them in times of peace, war, and conflict.
verses.33: For you were born from chaos; she also became the king. Her reign was deep and wide-ranging. Fire and many trees were destroyed. The spirit of Jehovah was like a stream in a forest of destruction.
